purpose: Falsify three structurally distinct daily cross-sectional mechanisms after Sprint 8 closed without a promotable regime-gated candidate.

data.survivorship_warning: Fixed present liquid universe; historical results do not remove survivorship risk.

execution.execution: next UTC daily open after completed signal information

cross_sectional_funding_carry.hypothesis: Perpetuals with low or negative trailing realized funding outperform high-funding perpetuals after accounting for realized next-period funding and trading costs.
cross_sectional_funding_carry.score: negative sum of realized funding rates strictly before execution open and within the trailing N calendar days, divided by N; this normalizes differing settlement cadence such as ENA
cross_sectional_funding_carry.ranking: long highest two scores +25% each and short lowest two scores -25% each
cross_sectional_funding_carry.principal_control: exact reversed ranking with identical funding accounting and timing

adaptive_ar1_forecast.hypothesis: Asset-specific short-run serial dependence, estimated without pooling signs across assets, contains cross-sectional information about the next daily return.
adaptive_ar1_forecast.model: for each asset separately fit r_j = alpha + phi*r_j-1 over the most recent N completed predictor-target pairs ending at completed day t; predict r_t+1 = alpha + phi*r_t
adaptive_ar1_forecast.ranking: long highest two predicted returns +25% each and short lowest two -25% each

cross_sectional_low_btc_beta.hypothesis: A market-neutral low-beta factor exists among liquid alt perpetuals, with lower trailing BTC beta outperforming higher trailing BTC beta.
cross_sectional_low_btc_beta.score: negative OLS slope of each alt return versus BTC over the most recent N completed returns ending at t, with intercept
cross_sectional_low_btc_beta.portfolio_universe: nine alts only; BTC is factor and has zero target weight
cross_sectional_low_btc_beta.ranking: long highest two scores (lowest beta) +25% each and short lowest two scores (highest beta) -25% each

family_falsification_gate.selection_if_family_passes: Among variants in an adjacent 1.5x-cost-positive neighborhood, select the upper median parameter; never select by maximum PnL.

evidence_boundary.positive_result_only_allows: new frozen candidate followed by independent reproduction, different-source D2, separately frozen non-overlapping temporal D3, and prospective D4
